essence: The complete nyāsa and associated rites are to be performed in the same manner as for Bhairavī.
The goddess formerly established this practice in Kāśī.
The practitioner should perform mantra recitation at night on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra in spring.
At that time, the goddess grants a boon to the mantra practitioner.
The goddess grants the practitioner the power to enchant birds, beasts, serpents, and similar creatures.
